working_hypotheses.wh_text: Cost and failure concentrate in a few high-volume, low-judgment sub-steps per layer.
supporting_evidence: Stage 4 §4.2 ranks 8 sub-steps by cost; top 3 (2c, 3c, 3a) dominate
PP1.1, PP2.1, PP3.3 individually confirm per-stage
working_hypotheses.gaps_in_test_coverage: Absolute dollar figures are sensitive to ASSUMED-N time-per-transaction inputs; concentration ranking is directionally robust but field validation needed for investor-grade numbers.

working_hypotheses.wh_text: Automation feasibility is gated by input-data format, not process importance.
supporting_evidence: Stage 6 §6.3 verdict: largely confirmed for 6 of 8 sub-steps
Stage 4 §4.6 verdict with corollary: 'structured data necessary but not sufficient'
working_hypotheses.gaps_in_test_coverage: Three sub-steps (1c CDM recall, 2d post-MCU routing, 3d TPA CDM admin) have fully STRUCTURED inputs yet remain unautomated — process accountability is a co-equal barrier the WH framing misses. The 'format gates feasibility, not importance' causal claim is confirmed directionally but the corollary (process importance is irrelevant) is untested.
working_hypotheses.suggested_deep_research_question: Operator interviews at Klinik Pintar (1c), HealthMetrics (2d), and PMCare (3d): 'What would it take to automate your CDM workflow given that the data already exists structured?' Answer determines whether WH2 framing should be revised to 'format OR process accountability gates feasibility'.

supporting_evidence: PP2.2 multi-lab F1=0.86 OCR benchmark + 3-6 lab fragmentation

working_hypotheses.gaps_in_test_coverage: OHD physician time per report (20-35 min) is ASSUMED-1 with no primary time-motion study — single most consequential unvalidated figure. Willingness to pay flagged as not sourced. Prodia OHI operations interview identified as required validation.

working_hypotheses.suggested_action: Flag to Stage 4: §4.6 should include a WH4 verdict row. No additional research needed.

working_hypotheses.wh_text: CDM recall and follow-up leak patients across every layer.
supporting_evidence: PP1.3 (GP recall), PP2.3 (post-MCU drop), PP3.5 (TPA CDM admin) each confirm layer-specific leakage
working_hypotheses.gaps_in_test_coverage: Cascade uses evidence from three different settings (Posbindu public ID, semiconductor SK private, BPJS Prolanis East Java) — not a single private-sector cross-layer cohort. Private GP CDM default rate is ASSUMED-12. 98.3% cumulative leakage is illustrative cascade model, not measured private-sector statistic.
working_hypotheses.suggested_action: Field-validation study: retrospective cohort using HealthMetrics claims + MCU programme + panel GP visit records for one large corporate client — single highest-value field study for WH5.

working_hypotheses.wh_text: Indonesia and Malaysia diverge sharply on readiness.
supporting_evidence: Stage 5 §5.1 36-cell matrix: MY Layer 3=3.7 vs ID=2.5 (largest delta)
Section 5.2 dim 5: MY English/bilingual notes vs ID Bahasa-only NLP gap
working_hypotheses.gaps_in_test_coverage: Five ASSUMED-5-N flags documented. Most consequential: ASSUMED-5-1 (HealthMetrics' actual sub-step 2d automation status) is pivotal for primary pilot recommendation. Layer 1 'sharp divergence' framing is weak (2.5 vs 2.7 — effectively tied).
working_hypotheses.suggested_deep_research_question: 30-min interview with HealthMetrics Head of Corporate Wellness: (1) Is post-MCU CDM routing automated today? (2) Actual observed follow-up rate (not 22.6% Korean proxy)? (3) ID-MY feature parity? This single interview validates or overturns the primary pilot recommendation.

summary.top_gap: ASSUMED-5-1 — HealthMetrics sub-step 2d automation status — is the single pivotal unvalidated question. If HealthMetrics already automates 2d, the Malaysia Layer 2 primary pilot recommendation collapses or pivots to Indonesia Layer 2 (Prodia, sub-step 2c).
summary.stage_4_documentation_gap: WH4 verdict missing from §4.6 synthesis table — non-research authoring gap.
